normalized.LeBel et al. (2023): LeBel et al. (2023) fMRI speech dataset

changes_made.explanation: Consolidated duplicate dataset entries and normalized model names. Removed redundant task description. The paper clearly addresses NLG through brain-to-text generation and continuous language reconstruction.
Normalized metric names to base forms (BLEU-1 → BLEU, Word Error Rate → WER). The paper explicitly uses these metrics to evaluate generated text quality against ground truth.
No LLMs are used as judges for evaluation. LLMs (GPT, GPT-2) are only used as text generators, not as evaluators of the generated outputs.
No human evaluation is conducted. The paper relies solely on automatic metrics for evaluation.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on brain-to-text generation using fMRI data. It uses standard NLG evaluation metrics but does not conduct human or LLM-based evaluation. The extraction was generally accurate but needed normalization and consolidation of duplicate entries.
